│ 🔍 KUBERNETES REMEDIATION & CONFIGURATION FIX                                │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                              │
│ INCIDENT   CPU CFS Bandwidth Throttling Mitigation                           │
│ STATUS     🟡 INCIDENT_PERFORMANCE_DEGRADATION                               │
│ SEVERITY   🔴 HIGH                                                           │
│ CONFIDENCE 🟢 95%                                                            │
│                                                                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ SUMMARY                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│ Setting hard `resources.limits.cpu` engages the Linux CFS (Completely Fair   │
│ Scheduler) quota mechanism. When multi-threaded applications burst, they     │
│ exhaust their 100ms CFS quota prematurely and are frozen for the remainder   │
│ of the period, generating severe latency spikes without crashing.            │
│                                                                              │
│ Detected condition:                                                          │
│   CFS Quota Throttling / Misconfigured CPU Limits                            │
│                                                                              │
│ Target Workload: deployment/frontend-web                                     │
│                                                                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ROOT CAUSE                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│ Hard CPU Limits (CFS Bandwidth Throttling)                                   │
│                                                                              │
│ Kubernetes enforces CPU limits using CFS quotas, not clock frequency. If     │
│ a pod with `cpu: "1"` runs 8 worker threads that burst for 12.5ms, it        │
│ consumes 100ms of CPU time instantly and is silenced for the next 87.5ms.    │
│ Modern SRE best practice recommends removing CPU limits entirely (or setting │
│ them to generous ceilings) while properly sizing CPU requests and memory     │
│ limits.                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│ Possible causes:                                                             │
│   • Over-restrictive `resources.limits.cpu`                                  │
│   • Multi-threaded burst traffic exceeding CFS 100ms quota windows          │
│   • Missing Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) triggering queue saturation     │
│                                                                              │
│ Diagnostic signature: K8S_CFS_THROTTLE_FIX_001                               │
│                                                                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 🔎 EVIDENCE                                                                  │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                              │
│ Metric Landmarks:                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│ cgroups  /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.stat                                         │
│          → nr_throttled: High rate of throttled periods                      │
│          → throttled_time: Excessive cumulative nanoseconds halted           │
│ K8s Spec resources.limits.cpu configured too close to baseline load          │
│                                                                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 📌 IMPACT                                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│ HIGH                                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ Requests stall mid-flight, causing severe tail (p95/p99) latency, gateway    │
│ timeouts (HTTP 504), and throughput degradation across the frontend cluster. │
│                                                                              │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 🛠 REMEDIATION                                                               │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                              │
│ 1. IMMEDIATE FIX: REMOVE CPU LIMIT VIA KUBECTL                               │
│                                                                              │
│ Remove the CPU limit completely to eliminate kernel CFS throttling, while    │
│ retaining a guaranteed CPU request and memory safeguards:                    │
